bash -c '
src="/home/openclaw/.openclaw/agents/main/sessions"
 dst="/home/openclaw/.openclaw/workspace/sessions"
 mkdir -p "$dst"
 # copy updated files (only newer)
 cp -u -v "$src"/*.jsonl "$dst" 2>/dev/null
 cd /home/openclaw/.openclaw/workspace
 git reset HEAD .
 safe_files=()
 for f in "$dst"/*.jsonl; do
   if grep -q -E "gh[ps]_[A-Za-z0-9_]{36}" "$f"; then
     echo "Skipping secret file $f"
   else
     safe_files+=("$f")
   fi
 done
 if [ ${#safe_files[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
   git add "${safe_files[@]}"
   staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only)
   echo "Staged files:"\n"$staged"
   git commit -m "Sync session transcripts (safe files)"
   git push
 else
   echo "No safe files to commit."
 fi
'
